description: Use this when a third-party service (Stripe, GitHub, a form, or your own app) should reach this agent through its Cooper inbox. Requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (omit when this key is limited to one inbox), name (1 to 40 characters: lowercase letters, digits, underscore, hyphen), signature (optional object with preset stripe, github, standard, or hmac_sha256, secret, optional header, and optional max_age_seconds). Returns the source and url once. url is the public POST target. Later reads show url_hint (last 4 characters) and never the token or the secret. At most 10 sources per inbox (HTTP 409 webhook_source_limit). A matching request writes webhook_source.received.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id, username, or email. Omit it when this key is limited to one inbox.

name.description: Source name, 1 to 40 characters: lowercase letters, digits, underscore, or hyphen.

signature.description: How to verify the sender. preset is stripe, github, standard, or hmac_sha256. secret is stored encrypted and never returned. header overrides the preset header. max_age_seconds defaults to 300 for stripe and standard.

header.description: Header that carries the signature. Required for hmac_sha256.

max_age_seconds.description: Timestamp tolerance in seconds for stripe and standard. Default 300. Integer from 1 to 86400.

secret.description: Signing secret from the sender. Not returned later. standard may be whsec_ plus base64.

name: cooper_webhook_source_create

outputSchema.description: The new webhook source. url is shown once.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

enabled.description: True when the object is active.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

signature.description: preset, header, and max_age_seconds. The secret is not included.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object last changed.

url.description: Public POST URL. Shown on create and rotate only.

url_hint.description: Last 4 characters of the receiver token.

title: Create a webhook source
